chunks: Satan is certainly your enemy, so hold him as a foe. He only calls his faction to be the residents of Hell.
ai.seo_question: What is the primary role of Satan according to this verse and who are his followers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ya-Sin (not The Originator) establishes the ontological enmity of Iblis, urging believers to adopt a stance of active vigilance rather than passive avoidance. Scholars emphasize that 'his party' (Hizb al-Shaytan) refers to those who consciously align their will with his deceptive narrative, leading to the ultimate consequence of the Hellfire.
